text: 国家统计局称，10月份，受“十一”假期前部分需求提前释放以及国际环境复杂多变等因素影响，制造业PMI降至49.3%。新动能保持较快增长。高技术制造业和装备制造业PMI分别为51.3%和50.6%，继续高于临界点，相关行业企业生产经营保持扩张，新质生产力延续良好发展态势。消费品行业和高耗能行业PMI分别为48.8%和47.3%，比上月下降1.9个和0.7个百分点，市场活跃度有所减弱。
text_en: The National Bureau of Statistics said that in October, affected by factors including the early release of some demand before the National Day holiday and the complex and volatile international environment, the manufacturing PMI fell to 49.3%. New growth drivers maintained relatively rapid growth. The PMIs for high-tech manufacturing and equipment manufacturing were 51.3% and 50.6%, respectively, continuing to stay above the threshold, with production and operations of enterprises in related industries remaining in expansion and new quality productive forces continuing their sound development momentum. The PMIs for the consumer goods industry and the high energy-consuming industry were 48.8% and 47.3%, down 1.9 and 0.7 percentage points from the previous month, indicating some weakening in market activity.
